+# Releases de staging
+
+O CI é **PREVIEW**, nunca publicação. `PUBLISH staging experimental` dispara somente
+de CI aprovado por push na main e seleciona automaticamente esse build.
+Um job skipped por CI falho/branch não é release. Não existe input `publish=false`.
+
+Cada execução preserva manifesto, artefato, tests.json, recibo, intenção de upload,
+operação e inspeções disponíveis como `staging-evidence-<run>-<attempt>` (90 dias).
+O histórico GitHub Deployments registra SHA/hash/build antes do envio, bloqueando
+novo upload do mesmo SHA se o runner morrer. Revisão só é aceita com destino exato,
+`isPublished=true` e `revisionId` numérico. Falha/timeout não dispara novo PATCH.
+
+Recuperação automática de rerun: recuperar recibo do artefato da execução anterior,
+conferir SHA/build/hash/Place/deployment e retomar **somente GET** da operação.
+Sem recibo/operação recuperável: bloquear, baixar evidências e investigar, sem PATCH.
+Se upload foi rejeitado definitivamente, corrigir e produzir novo SHA/build; se
+aceito, não reenviar. Falha engine após publicação é release publicada **com falha**,
+não release não publicada. Corrigir por PR e publicar novo candidato.
+
+Inspeção Open Cloud compara os Sources persistidos da revisão e executa Bootstrap
+explicitamente em instância isolada. Não inicia scripts automaticamente nem simula
+física/jogadores; **não** equivale a RUNTIME_OK/PLAYTEST_OK em servidor normal.
+Sem permissão Luau Execution, registrar PENDING_ACCESS e entregar experimental,
+nunca PASS fictício. Produção não é destino suportado por estes scripts.
+Somente 401/403 são falta de acesso; 404/COMPLETE com error/retorno inválido falham
+a verificação. Deployment success só é emitido após a tentativa de inspeção e sua

+local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
+local BuildInfo = require(script.Parent.BuildInfo)
+local Health = {}

+	folder.Name = "MythragonHealth"
+	folder:SetAttribute("GitSha", BuildInfo.gitSha)
+	folder:SetAttribute("BuildRunId", BuildInfo.buildRunId)
+	folder:SetAttribute("PlaceVersion", game.PlaceVersion)
+	folder:SetAttribute("Experimental", true)
+	folder:SetAttribute("State", "INITIALIZING")
+	folder.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
+	local self = setmetatable({ folder = folder, failures = {}, components = {} }, Health)
+	self:log("bootstrap", "INITIALIZING")
+	return self
+end
+
+function Health:log(component, state, message)
+	local record = {
+		project = "MYTHRAGON", gitSha = BuildInfo.gitSha, buildRunId = BuildInfo.buildRunId,
+		universeId = game.GameId, placeId = game.PlaceId, placeVersion = game.PlaceVersion,
+		jobId = game.JobId, component = component, state = state, message = message,
+	}
+	local encoded = HttpService:JSONEncode(record)
+	if state == "FAILED" or state == "BLOCKED" then warn(encoded) else print(encoded) end
+end
+
+function Health:stage(name, callback, cleanup)
+	assert(not self.components[name], "Duplicate bootstrap stage: " .. name)
+	self.components[name] = "INITIALIZING"
+	self.folder:SetAttribute(name, "INITIALIZING")
+	local ok, result = xpcall(callback, debug.traceback)
+	local state = if ok then "READY" else "FAILED"
+	self.components[name] = state
+	self.folder:SetAttribute(name, state)
+	if not ok then
+		self.failures[name] = tostring(result)
+		if cleanup then
+			local cleanOk, cleanError = pcall(cleanup)
+			if not cleanOk then self:log(name .. ".cleanup", "FAILED", tostring(cleanError)) end
+		end
+	end
+	self:log(name, state, if ok then nil else tostring(result))
+	return ok, result
+end
+
+function Health:block(name, reason)
+	self.components[name] = "BLOCKED"
+	self.failures[name] = reason
+	self.folder:SetAttribute(name, "BLOCKED")
+	self:log(name, "BLOCKED", reason)
+end
+
+function Health:finish()
+	local healthy = next(self.failures) == nil
+	self.folder:SetAttribute("State", if healthy then "READY" else "FAILED")
+	self:log("bootstrap", if healthy then "READY" else "FAILED")
+	return healthy
+end
+
+return Health

+"""Local durable task leases across worktrees. Does NOT pretend to launch desktop agents."""
+import argparse
+import datetime
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import re
+import sqlite3
+import subprocess
+import uuid
+
+
+def database():
+    common = subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "--git-common-dir"], text=True).strip()
+    folder = Path(common).resolve() / "mythragon-coordination"
+    folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+    db = sqlite3.connect(folder / "leases.sqlite", timeout=30)
+    db.execute("""CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tasks(
+        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner TEXT NOT NULL, token TEXT NOT NULL,
+        state TEXT NOT NULL, worktree TEXT NOT NULL, base TEXT NOT NULL,
+        checkpoint TEXT NOT NULL, updated TEXT NOT NULL)""")
+    db.execute("""CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS events(
+        task TEXT, owner TEXT, state TEXT, checkpoint TEXT, updated TEXT)""")
+    return db
+
+
+def change(db, task, owner, mode, token=None, checkpoint=""):
+    now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
+    with db:
+        db.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
+        row = db.execute("SELECT owner,token,state,worktree FROM tasks WHERE id=?", (task,)).fetchone()
+        worktree = str(Path.cwd())
+        if mode == "claim":
+            if row:
+                raise ValueError("Task already recorded; resume with its token, do not duplicate execution")
+            active = db.execute("SELECT id FROM tasks WHERE worktree=? AND state='IMPLEMENTING'",
+                                (worktree,)).fetchone()
+            if active:
+                raise ValueError("Worktree already leased by task " + active[0])
+            token = uuid.uuid4().hex
+            base = subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip()
+            db.execute("INSERT INTO tasks VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
+                       (task, owner, token, "IMPLEMENTING", worktree, base, checkpoint, now))
+            state = "IMPLEMENTING"
+        else:
+            if not row or row[0] != owner or row[1] != token or row[3] != worktree:
+                raise ValueError("Wrong task owner/token/worktree")
+            if row[2] != "IMPLEMENTING":
+                raise ValueError("Task is not active; no silent reactivation")
+            state = "IMPLEMENTING" if mode == "checkpoint" else "REVIEW"
+            db.execute("UPDATE tasks SET state=?,checkpoint=?,updated=? WHERE id=?",
+                       (state, checkpoint, now, task))
+        db.execute("INSERT INTO events VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)", (task, owner, state, checkpoint, now))
+    return {"task": task, "owner": owner, "token": token, "state": state, "updated": now}
+
+
+def main():
+    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    p.add_argument("mode", choices=["claim", "checkpoint", "submit", "status"])
+    p.add_argument("--task")
+    p.add_argument("--owner", choices=["CODEX", "GLM"])
+    p.add_argument("--token")
+    p.add_argument("--checkpoint", default="")
+    a = p.parse_args()
+    db = database()
+    if a.mode == "status":
+        for row in db.execute("SELECT id,owner,state,worktree,base,checkpoint,updated FROM tasks"):
+            print(json.dumps(row))
+    else:
+        if not a.task or not re.fullmatch("[A-Z0-9-]+", a.task) or not a.owner:
+            p.error("--task ID and --owner required")
+        print(json.dumps(change(db, a.task, a.owner, a.mode, a.token, a.checkpoint)))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""MYTHRAGON build identity and fail-closed artifact contracts (standard library)."""
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import re
+import subprocess
+import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+UNIVERSE = "10777026486"
+PLACE = "135004978091658"
+EXPECTED = {"latunia": True, "island_slots": 5, "detailed_islands": 3,
+            "travel_prompts": 10, "latunia_gate": True,
+            "provisional_islands": ["Gelo", "Selva"]}
+
+
+def digest(data):
+    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
+
+
+def sources(root=ROOT):
+    return {p.relative_to(root / "src/server").as_posix(): p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+            for p in sorted((root / "src/server").rglob("*.luau"))}
+
+
+def normalized(text):
+    return text.replace("\r\n", "\n")
+
+
+def artifact_sources(path):
+    """Read exact Rojo script hierarchy; reject duplicate paths."""
+    tree = ET.parse(path)
+    found = {}
+
+    def walk(item, parents):
+        props = item.find("Properties")
+        name = props.find("string[@name='Name']").text if props is not None else None
+        at = parents + [name or item.attrib["class"]]
+        if item.attrib["class"] in ("Script", "LocalScript", "ModuleScript"):
+            key = "/".join(at)
+            if key in found:
+                raise ValueError("Duplicate script: " + key)
+            source = props.find("*[@name='Source']")
+            if source is None:
+                raise ValueError("Missing source: " + key)
+            found[key] = normalized(source.text or "")
+        for child in item.findall("Item"):
+            walk(child, at)
+
+    for item in tree.getroot().findall("Item"):
+        walk(item, [])
+    return found
+
+
+def instance_path(path):
+    suffix = ".server.luau" if path.endswith(".server.luau") else ".luau"
+    return "ServerScriptService/Mythragon/" + path[:-len(suffix)]
+
+
+def verify_sources(artifact, expected):
+    actual = artifact_sources(artifact)
+    wanted = {instance_path(p): normalized(s) for p, s in expected.items()}
+    if actual != wanted:
+        missing = sorted(set(wanted) - set(actual))
+        extra = sorted(set(actual) - set(wanted))
+        changed = sorted(p for p in wanted.keys() & actual.keys() if wanted[p] != actual[p])
+        raise ValueError(f"Artifact source mismatch: missing={missing}, extra={extra}, changed={changed}")
+    return actual
+
+
+def identity(sha, run):
+    if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", sha) or not re.fullmatch(r"[1-9][0-9]*|local", run):
+        raise ValueError("Invalid build SHA/run")
+    return f'return table.freeze({{ gitSha = "{sha}", buildRunId = "{run}", experimental = true }})\n'
+
+

+    dest = ROOT / "src/server/Diagnostics/BuildInfo.luau"

+

+    info = included["ServerScriptService/Mythragon/Diagnostics/BuildInfo"]
+    if info != identity(sha, run):
+        raise ValueError("Embedded build identity does not match")
+    return {"schema": 1, "project": "MYTHRAGON", "release_id": "REC-001-" + sha[:12],
+            "git_sha": sha, "build_run_id": run, "artifact": "mythragon.rbxlx",
+            "sha256": digest(artifact.read_bytes()), "universe_id": UNIVERSE, "place_id": PLACE,
+            "expected_content": EXPECTED, "modules_expected": sorted(included),
+            "source_sha256": {p: digest(s.encode()) for p, s in included.items()},
+            "assets_expected": sorted(set(re.findall(r"rbxassetid://(\d+)", "\n".join(included.values())))),
+            "tests": json.loads((ROOT / "dist/tests.json").read_text()),
+            "state": "PREVIEW_OK", "revision": None, "operation": None,
+            "verification": {"persisted": "PENDING", "engine_bootstrap": "PENDING",
+                             "runtime_new_server": "PENDING", "client": "PENDING", "visual": "PENDING"},
+            "pending": ["Fresh normal server runtime", "Physics/client/mobile/multiplayer playtest",
+                        "Owner visual evaluation", "Gelo/Selva detailed content",
+                        "Engine inspection specs are shipped as inert ModuleScripts, not automatic tests",
+                        "Studio engine specs and isolated cloud probe share contracts; no player simulation"]}
+
+
+def verify_manifest(folder, sha, run):
+    folder = Path(folder)
+    m = json.loads((folder / "manifest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

+            sha, str(run), UNIVERSE, PLACE):
+        raise ValueError("Wrong SHA/build/destination")
+    if m["state"] != "PREVIEW_OK" or m["sha256"] != digest((folder / "mythragon.rbxlx").read_bytes()):
+        raise ValueError("Artifact checksum/state invalid")
+    actual = artifact_sources(folder / "mythragon.rbxlx")
+    if {p: digest(s.encode()) for p, s in actual.items()} != m["source_sha256"]:
+        raise ValueError("Artifact modules differ from manifest")
+    if sorted(actual) != m["modules_expected"] or m["expected_content"] != EXPECTED:

+    if actual["ServerScriptService/Mythragon/Diagnostics/BuildInfo"] != identity(sha, str(run)):
+        raise ValueError("Artifact identity mismatch")
+    if not m["tests"] or any(t["status"] != "PASS" for t in m["tests"]):

+    return m
+
+
+def main():
+    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    p.add_argument("mode", choices=["prepare", "manifest", "verify"])
+    p.add_argument("--sha", default=os.environ.get("BUILD_SHA"))
+    p.add_argument("--run", default=os.environ.get("BUILD_RUN_ID", "local"))

+    else:
+        verify_manifest(ROOT / "dist", sha, args.run)
+        print("Artifact, identity, SHA-256 and available tests: PASS")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
